title: Vent connector manifold.
officialText:
Where the vent connectors are combined prior to entering the vertical portion of the common vent to form a common vent manifold, the size of the common vent manifold and the common vent shall be determined by applying a 10-percent reduction (0.90 × maximum common vent capacity) to the common vent capacity part of the common vent tables. The length of the common vent connector manifold (LM) shall not exceed 1½ feet for each inch (457 mm for each 25.4
mm) of common vent connector manifold diameter (D) (see Figure 504.3.4). COMMON VENT CAPACITY
